name: Chibi Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: A suspected Rug Pull occurred on the Chibi Finance project on Arbitrum, and $1 million worth of cryptocurrency was drained. The stolen funds have been converted into approximately 555 ETH and transferred to Tornado Cash after bridging from Arbitrum to Ethereum.
